source.quote: iFi Pro iDSD manual, read 2026-11-20, which states it plainly: « Inputs other than USB are currently limited to maximum sample rates of 192kHz PCM and DSD64 via DoP », against USB at 768 kHz and DSD1024. This record is the range's catch-all and the figures are the Pro iDSD's; the Neo and micro models were not documented per input.
